recommendation: Keep the no-change audit. Any future clarification should be opened as current StructureDefinition/logical-model work rather than reviving retired DataElement-specific prose.
issue_request: FHIR-6897 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification OO clarification request from the 2015 May SDC ballot. It asked for Scope and Usage prose explaining that DataElement defined individual pieces of data that might be collected or stored, including FHIR elements, questionnaire questions, data-store elements, and non-FHIR specifications such as HL7 v2, CDA, and CDISC.
initial_application: Commit cacb4626a33 added the requested paragraph to source/dataelement/dataelement-introduction.xml. Commit 0cabf5ff9d later made link/text-style refinements to that paragraph, and commit 33b409a4b6 later deleted the historical DataElement introduction source during current build-source rework.
additional_context: Later final decision FHIR-13094 removed DataElement and replaced it with StructureDefinition logical models; the combined branch already contains current cleanup for that decision in c1a07840fd. Current source has DataElement commented out of source/fhir.ini, no source/dataelement directory, and history.html records DataElement as removed. Current logical-model guidance carries the non-FHIR data-modeling concept in active source.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. Restoring the old DataElement sentence would revive guidance for a retired resource, and adding duplicate text to StructureDefinition or logical.html is unnecessary because current active narrative already covers the surviving concept after FHIR-13094.

related_jiras.note: Final OO decision to remove DataElement and replace it with StructureDefinition logical models; it explains why the old FHIR-6897 DataElement prose should not be restored.
